  FROM card_bankomats a ,account b, smart.tenostat c where a.MAINACOUNT=b.id and c.ACC_ID=a.mainacount
   
  union

 SELECT a.atmname,b.acc_no ,c.OSTAT
  FROM card_bankomats a ,account b, smart.tenostat  c where a.interaccount=b.id and c.ACC_ID=a.interaccount

  FROM card_domestic a ,account b, smart.tenostat  c where a.h25id=b.id and c.ACC_ID=a.h25id
  
  union
  
    SELECT a.bankname,b.acc_no ,c.OSTAT
  FROM card_domestic a ,account b, tenostat c where a.h45id=b.id and c.ACC_ID=a.h45id 
  
  union
  
    SELECT 'Kliring45',b.acc_no ,c.OSTAT
  FROM card_domestic a ,account b, tenostat  c

datasets.name: OracleDataSet1
datasets.sql:
SELECT card_main.findfilial (f.filialid) AS filial, t.val_name AS valyuta,
       a.acc_no AS hesab_28, z.ostat AS hesab_28_qaliq, t.ostat AS plan28,
       b.acc_no AS hesab_48, s.ostat AS hesab_48_qaliq, k.ostat AS plan48
  FROM filialaccounts f,
       ACCOUNT a,
       ACCOUNT b,
       smart.avalute_t t,
       smart.tenostat  z,
       smart.tenostat  s,
       smart.lazyrest t,
       smart.lazyrest k
 WHERE f.valid = t.valute
   AND f.accid28 = a.ID
   AND f.accid48 = b.ID
   AND f.accid28 = z.acc_id
   AND f.accid48 = s.acc_id
   AND f.accid28 = t.acc_id
   AND f.accid48 = k.acc_id
   AND f.filialid <> 0

datasets.name: OracleDataSet1
datasets.sql:
SELECT card_main.findfilial (f.filialid) AS filial, t.val_name AS valyuta,
       a.acc_no AS hesab, z.ostat AS hesab_qaliq,
       NVL (card_main.commitrestdebt (f.accid28), 0) AS dtesdiq,
       NVL (card_main.lazyrestdebt (f.accid28), 0) AS dplan,
       NVL (card_main.commitrestkredit (f.accid28), 0) AS ktesdiq,
       NVL (card_main.lazyrestkredit (f.accid28), 0) AS kplan,

      card_main.findmoh28(z.ostat,
      NVL (card_main.commitrestdebt (f.accid28), 0),
      NVL (card_main.lazyrestdebt (f.accid28), 0),
      NVL (card_main.commitrestkredit (f.accid28), 0),
      NVL (card_main.lazyrestkredit (f.accid28), 0)) as Verilecek_mebleq


  FROM filialaccounts f,
       ACCOUNT a,
      
       smart.avalute_t t,
       smart.tenostat  z
      
 WHERE f.valid = t.valute
   AND f.accid28 = a.ID
  
   AND f.accid28 = z.acc_id
   
   AND f.filialid <> 0

UNION


SELECT card_main.findfilial (f.filialid) AS filial, t.val_name AS valyuta,

       b.acc_no AS hesab, s.ostat AS hesab_qaliq,
       NVL (card_main.commitrestdebt (f.accid48), 0) AS dtesdiq,
       NVL (card_main.lazyrestdebt (f.accid48), 0) AS dplan,
       NVL (card_main.commitrestkredit (f.accid48), 0) AS ktesdiq,
       NVL (card_main.lazyrestkredit (f.accid48), 0) AS kplan,
    
    card_main.findmoh48(s.ostat,
      NVL (card_main.commitrestdebt (f.accid48), 0),
      NVL (card_main.lazyrestdebt (f.accid48), 0),
      NVL (card_main.commitrestkredit (f.accid48), 0),
      NVL (card_main.lazyrestkredit (f.accid48), 0)) as Verilecek_mebleq


  FROM filialaccounts f,
       
       ACCOUNT b,
       smart.avalute_t t,
     
       smart.tenostat  s
 WHERE f.valid = t.valute
  
   AND f.accid48 = b.ID
  
   AND f.accid48 = s.acc_id
   AND f.filialid <> 0
ORDER BY HESAB
